shots.prompt: dancers shake their shoulders in eskista rhythm, ululating women sway, drummers pound, dust and steam glow in the lamplight, camera pushes slowly into the crowd
he walks toward the camera with a tired but warm smile, the gabi sways, dust drifts in the golden backlight, camera slowly pushes in
the gatekeeper looks the visitor up and down slowly, raises his hand, turns his face away in dismissal, camera holds low and still
the gabi flies onto its peg, water splashes and droplets scatter, hands move fast through frame, camera static
he throws the velvet kabba over his shoulders with one arm, grips the walking stick, chin up, camera pushes in with him
the hero walks in slow motion toward the camera, the gatekeeper bows low and holds it, guests turn and begin to ululate, camera tracks backward ahead of him
hands pour tej into small glasses, steam rises off the wot, servers set the giant mesob down in front of the honoured guest, camera glides across the food
he blinks once, slowly, eyes moving across the feast, everything behind him frozen, camera locked on his face
the hand smears the stew slowly and deliberately across the white cloth, sauce drips, tej pours over the velvet shoulder, camera holds tight
he wipes his hands calmly, lifts his gaze from the host to the crowd, and breaks into a slow triumphant smirk, camera pushes in very slowly
